description:
FILED s403 (Fable), from the s402 review §1.4 by-product: with PCL_DROP_ANNOUNCE=all,
Data/Dump.pm line 325 drops `$kstat_sum2 += length($key)*length($key);`.  Probed
in a plain program (NOT module mode) — the drop is general and PRE-EXISTING:

    my ($s,$k)=(0,"ab");
    $s += length($k)*length($k);   print "$s\n";   # perl 4   PCL: DROPPED (prints 0)
    $s  = length($k)*length($k);   print "$s\n";   # perl 4   PCL: DROPPED (prints "")
    $s += length($k) * length($k); print "$s\n";   # perl 4   PCL 4   (spaces: fine)
    $s += length($k)*2;            print "$s\n";   # perl 4   PCL 4
    $s += 2*length($k);            print "$s\n";   # perl 8   PCL 8

CAUSE = PPI 1.291 (measured with PPI::Dumper): after a `PPI::Structure::List`
`( ... )` the token `*length` is lexed as PPI::Token::Symbol '*length' (a glob),
not Operator '*' + Word 'length'.  So the statement reaches PExpr as
`Word List Symbol List` and falls through: "Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [".
The trigger is `)` immediately followed by `*` immediately followed by a word
char (typeglob-looking).  Same PPI family as #351 (operator-vs-term decision
after a token that ends a term); the fix layer is the same: the raw-token-stream
repair family in Parser2 (`_repair_*`) — split the Symbol into Operator + Word
when the previous significant token ENDS A TERM (`)`, `]`, a subscript `}`,
a Symbol, a Number, a Quote) — perl's rule, not a word list.

RULE 13 applies: the repair commit MUST add ppi-upstream-bugs.md §12 (repro
above, Dumper output, PPI 1.291) + a failing row in docs/ppi-bug-report.t
(Bug 9, bump tests => 9) + a canary row in Pl/t/misc-fixes-02.t.  Guard rows for
the five shapes above in transpile-test-10.t.

SIZING is free: `PCL: statement dropped … -- Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [`
lines whose text contains `)*` — one grep over the s402 gate-set-scan stderr
(both populations) plus PCL_DROP_ANNOUNCE=all over the CPAN board's modules.
Queue: with #351 (same repair family; one commit is fine if the condition is
shared: "a Symbol/Regex-vs-Operator decision after a term-ending token").


SIZED s404 (session B by-product): ZERO occurrences in both populations —
the `)*name` shape appears in NO .t file of perl-tests or perl's own t/, and
in no lib/ shim (657 files scanned via the drop announcements).  It is a
CPAN-code shape (Data::Dump:325).  Consequence for the fix: its guard rows
must be WRITTEN (transpile-test-10.t + the ppi-bug-report row), not harvested
from a population, and no sweep/companion row will move when it lands.


DONE s404 (commit a46aa3f), with #351 in one commit — the repair layer and the
reparse mechanism are shared even though each predicate is its own.
_repair_glob_multiply splits `*name` back into operator + word when the previous
significant token ENDS A TERM (_ends_term: `)`, `]`, a SUBSCRIPT-closing `}`,
a Symbol, a Number, a Quote).  The block-closing `}` case (`sub f {…} *bar =
\&f;`) is a REAL glob and is excluded by asking the tree which structure the
brace closes — both spellings probed against perl.

Population: ZERO sites in perl-tests or perl's t/ (the sizing said so and the
A/B confirmed it: no file's emission moved for #354).  Guard rows were WRITTEN,
not harvested: Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t covers all seven shapes including
`2*length` (PPI gets it right) and the real glob.

RULE 13 done: ppi-upstream-bugs.md §12, ppi-bug-report.t Bug 9 (tests => 10),
canary in Pl/t/misc-fixes-02.t.
subject: PPI mis-lexes `)*name` as a GLOB — `length($k)*length($k)` is DROPPED whole (silent wrong; Data::Dump line 325)
